theBound: AuthBypassDetector.analyzeFile selects routeDefTrigger ?? triggers[0]. Only a route-def trigger earns the whole-file payload; every sentinel trigger is sent through extractContextWindow as lines trigger-8 .. trigger+16.

defectOutsidePayload.text: if (!options || !options.secret) throw new Error('secret should be set');
defectOutsidePayload.reading: The only validation the options object receives. No algorithms requirement; options is then passed verbatim to jwt.verify at line 100, so the token's own alg header selects the verification algorithm. This is the shape fixed in express-jwt 6.0.0 by requiring options.algorithms (CVE-2020-15084).

result.note: No verdict was obtained and none is claimed. What is measured is that the payload the model receives contains the verify call and not the option handling that makes it unsafe.

payloadSent.derivation: source formula; the instrument's text-search window locator misreported 426 on this file because the payload's first line repeats earlier in the file, and is not to be believed on files with repeated lines

whatThisDoesNotEstablish: How often a sentinel file's decisive context lies outside the window. Two files, two repositories, one with a known defect. Not a rate.
boundToTheCode: Goes false if sentinel triggers gain the whole-file payload, if triggers[0] selection changes, or if the window changes shape.
